LanguageData.ABY_CrownReactorMultilance.description: A crown-reactor weapon assembled from Saint-grade containment geometry and dominion rail lattices. Its four emitters do not simply fire; they pronounce a staged verdict, first fixing the target, then shearing its systems, cutting through the line behind it, and ending with a crowned discharge that punishes anything still standing.
